subtopic: gRPC, Protocol Buffers and Streaming RPC
question_text: Why does Protocol Buffers wire format omit field names and rely exclusively on field tag numbers and wire types?

options.text: To prevent reverse engineering of proprietary APIs
To achieve extreme compactness and sub-nanosecond binary decoding without string parsing overhead
To enable native encryption during transmission
Because field names are incompatible with UTF-8

answer_explanation: Omitting string field names from every serialized payload reduces payload size by up to 80% compared to JSON and allows fast bitmask decoding of field tag numbers.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: Omitting string field names from every serialized payload reduces payload size by up to 80% compared to JSON and allows fast bitmask decoding of field tag numbers.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Selects the exact correct technical option.
